materi.deskripsi: Materi Bahasa Inggris VERSI DALAM persiapan TKA 2026 berbasis bank Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams): bab 1 Narrative Text & bab 2 Descriptive Text (struktur, ciri bahasa, tipe soal, strategi jawab). Terbuka semua kelas/program.
daftarPustaka: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bahasa Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text hlm. 71-74 & 02 Descriptive Text hlm. 76-78: BASIS materi & latihan; kunci & pembahasan detail dari 08 Pembahasan hlm. 44-47.

Teks contoh bank diadaptasi dari sumber terbuka: legenda Naka Cave (thailand.go.th), Tristan da Cunha & Seed Vault (britannica.com), Great Blue Hole (unesco.org) — dikutip ringkas untuk keperluan pendidikan.
Bagan struktur teks (narrative & descriptive) = penunjang orisinal tim kurikulum Gemilang (berlabel penunjang).

bab.ringkasan: Narrative = cerita berkronologi dengan moral: orientation-complication-resolution-coda, past tense & temporal conjunctions; strategi menjawab topic, inference, reference, moral value, dan tabel True/False.

sections.teks: A. What Is a Narrative Text? (Cerita yang Menangkap Pembaca)

Bayangkan menonton film legenda: ada tokoh, tempat, masalah, puncak ketegangan, dan akhir yang memberi pelajaran. Itulah narrative text — cerita fiksi atau non-fiksi yang menyusun rangkaian peristiwa secara kronologis. Social function-nya ganda: menghibur (to amuse/entertain) DAN mengajarkan nilai moral (moral lesson).

Narrative adalah teks pembuka paket Bahasa Inggris TKA. Soal favorit: topic/ide utama, inference (kesimpulan tersirat), rujukan kata (reference), moral value, dan True/False tabel berdasarkan teks. Kuncinya satu: semua jawaban harus JEJAK di teks, bukan pendapat pribadi.
B. Generic Structure: Empat Stasiun Cerita

Setiap narrative berhenti di empat stasiun: Orientation (memperkenalkan tokoh & latar) -> Complication (masalah muncul & memuncak) -> Resolution (masalah terselesaikan) -> Coda (perubahan tokoh & pelajaran yang dipetik; opsional). Mengenali stasiun membantu menjawab soal "apa yang terjadi selanjutnya" dan "mengapa tokoh bertindak".

sections.keterangan: Bagan alur empat stasiun narrative dari kiri ke kanan: Orientation (kotak biru: tokoh & latar), panah ke Complication (kotak merah: masalah memuncak), panah ke Resolution (kotak hijau: masalah terselesaikan), panah ke Coda (kotak amber: perubahan & pelajaran); di bawah tiap kotak tertulis pertanyaan pemandu: siapa & di mana? masalah apa? bagaimana selesai? apa yang dipelajari?

items: Orientation menjawab WHO & WHERE: tokoh, waktu, latar.
Complication adalah mesin cerita: tanpa masalah tidak ada narrative.
Resolution menutup konflik: menang, kalah, atau berubah.
Coda membawa moral: apa yang tokoh (dan pembaca) pelajari.
Soal "moral value" hampir selalu berumah di Coda atau resolusi akhir.

sections.teks: C. Language Features: Sidik Jari Narrative

rows.v: long ago, one day, ultimately, as the waters receded
once upon a time, for three years

sections.teks: D. Kinds of Narrative & Cara Menjawab 5 Tipe Soal

items: Fairy Tale & Fable: dunia ajaib, hewan berbicara, moral eksplisit.
Legend & Myth: asal-usul tempat/fenomena (mis. legenda gua Naga).
Science Fiction & Fantasy: aturan dunia buatan yang konsisten.
Historical Fiction: tokoh fiksi di latar sejarah nyata.

sections.teks: Contoh terpecah langkah — inference & reference (pola bank soal). Soal tipe reference: "He was transformed into a giant serpent." He = ? Langkah 1: cari subjek kalimat sebelumnya: King U-Lue dihukum? Bukan — kalimat sebelum menyebut the Naga King rising; namun subjek grammatical terdekat pada kalimat anteseden adalah King U-Lue yang berubah -> kunci bank: D (King U-Lue). Langkah 2: untuk inference: kutip kalimat pendukung dulu, baru simpulkan (mis. pernikahan terlarang = pemicu kehancuran -> kunci E). Langkah 3: buang opsi yang tidak berjejak teks.

Topic = gabungan tokoh+masalah+latar dalam satu kalimat; inference = benar menurut teks tapi TIDAK ditulis; reference = ganti kata dengan kandidat, baca ulang, pilih yang tidak janggal; moral = kalimat nilai universal (bukan detail cerita).

Mode live: bacakan satu paragraf Orientation, minta siswa menebak stasiun berikutnya; lempar soal reference sebagai kuis cepat. Mode mandiri: tekankan kebiasaan menggarisbawahi kalimat bukti sebelum memilih jawaban.

ujiPemahaman.soal: What is the topic of the text?
opsi: The geological process of sun cracking in Thailand
A historical account of the Mekong River's floods
The tragic legend behind the formation of Naka Cave
A romance between two noble families in ancient Thailand
The architectural grandeur of the Rattaphan Nakhon city
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Ide utama teks adalah legenda tragis di balik asal-usul Gua Naka di Thailand: kutukan Raja U-Lue hingga tubuhnya berubah menjadi batu. Seluruh isi teks menceritakan asal-usul itu, bukan geologi, sejarah sungai, romansa, atau arsitektur. Jawaban: C.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 1 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: C); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What can be inferred from the text?
opsi: The Naka Cave was built by the people of Rattaphan Nakhon as a tomb.
The princess intentionally deceived the King by hiding her serpent form.
King U-Lue was a merciful leader who prioritized his grandson's happiness.
The Naga King attacked the city because he wanted to expand his territory.
The forbidden marriage was the primary catalyst for the kingdom's destruction.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Inferensi harus berjejak teks: paragraf 1 menyatakan "...but its downfall began when King U-Lue's grandson, Prince Fa Rung, fell in love with a beautiful Naga princess..." -> pernikahan terlarang itu pemicu utama kehancuran kerajaan (E). Opsi lain tidak didukung: gua bukan makam buatan; putri tidak sengaja menipu; raja justru mengusir; Naga King menyerang karena balas dendam, bukan ekspansi.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 2 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: E); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: "He was transformed into a giant serpent, eternally bound to the Phu Langka mountains." The word "He" in the sentence refers to ....
opsi: The Princess.
The Naga King.
A royal servant.
King U-Lue.
The grandson.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Kata "He" merujuk pada subjek yang disebutkan sebelumnya dalam rangkaian hukuman: King U-Lue yang tubuhnya menegang dan bersisik -> ia yang diubah menjadi ular raksasa. Kunci bank: D.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 3 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: D); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Decide whether the following statements are True or False based on the Naga legend text!
baris: The marriage between Prince Fa Rung and Nakkhrinthrani lasted for three years.
The princess was banished because the King felt insult by her true form.
Bueng Khong Long was once a vibrant city before it became a lake.
King U-Lue was killed immediately by the Naga King during the flood.
The curse on the King will last until the land reaches a state of perfect virtue.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: True: pernikahan tiga tahun (paragraf 1 "for three years, the kingdom celebrated their love"). True: raja merasa dihina wujud ular putri lalu mengusirnya (paragraf 2). True: Bueng Khong Long dahulu kota hidup sebelum jadi danau (paragraf 3). False: King U-Lue tidak tewas seketika — ia dikutuk berubah menjadi batu/ular, "a punishment far worse than death". True: kutukan berakhir saat tanah mencapai kebajikan sempurna (paragraf 4). Kunci bank: T, T, T, F, T.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 4 (kunci & pembahasan per pernyataan dari 08: T,T,T,F,T); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Decide whether the following statements are True or False based on the miller-and-sorcerer story!
baris: The miller knew from the start that he was bargaining with a sorcerer.
The girl's hands miraculously grew back while she was in the mountains.
The sorcerer manipulated the king's letters to cause a conflict.
The king recognized his wife immediately because of her silver hands.
The story suggests that internal virtue can act as a shield against evil.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: False: penggiling tidak tahu ia berurusan dengan penyihir (paragraf 1 "Unknowingly, he had promised his daughter to the stranger"). True: tangan gadis tumbuh kembali secara ajaib di gunung (paragraf 2). True: penyihir mencegat & memanipulasi surat raja (paragraf 2-3). False: raja TIDAK mengenali istrinya dari tangan perak ("He did not recognize her at first because of her restored hands"). True: pesan moral penutup — kebajikan internal adalah perisai dari kejahatan. Kunci bank: F, T, T, F, T.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 12 (kunci & pembahasan per pernyataan dari 08: F,T,T,F,T); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What is the moral value of the Owl-and-Nightingale story?
opsi: Wisdom is only found in traditional and functional ways of living.
True wisdom lies in recognizing that different forms of beauty can coexist.
Competition is necessary to determine which talents are superior to others.
Creativity should be avoided if it does not serve a practical, daily purpose.
Silence is always more valuable than artistic expression in the natural world.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Moral ditemukan di resolusi: Falcon menolak menyatakan pemenang dan menjelaskan bahwa suara Owl dan lagu Nightingale masing-masing punya tempat -> kebijaksanaan sejati = mengakui koeksistensi berbagai bentuk keindahan (B). Opsi lain justru bertentangan dengan pesan teks.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 13 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: B); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What is the tone of the Owl-and-Nightingale text?
opsi: Humorous
Reflective
Indifferent
Sarcastic
Critical
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Laras teks reflektif: narasi mengajak pembaca merenungkan makna filosofis di balik perbedaan karakter Owl dan Nightingale, bukan sekadar informasi faktual atau humor. Kunci bank: B.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 14 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: B); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What is the purpose of the Owl-and-Nightingale text?
opsi: To teach readers the importance of diversity in expression
To explain the technical history of animal fables in literature
To criticize the Nightingale for being too loud during the night
To persuade readers to protect the habitats of endangered birds
To describe the biological differences between owls and falcons
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Tujuan utama: menyampaikan pesan moral tentang keberagaman ekspresi — setiap suara mempunyai keunggulan dan tempatnya sendiri (paragraf akhir). Kunci bank: A.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 15 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: A); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What can be concluded from the Owl-and-Nightingale text?
opsi: The Falcon found it easy to decide who was the superior bird in the forest.
The Nightingale changed her song to make it more functional for the Owl.
The forest animals preferred the Owl's wisdom over the Nightingale's joy.
The Owl eventually admitted that the Nightingale's song was better than his call.
Value is subjective, and different perspectives can both hold merit simultaneously.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Kesimpulan: nilai itu subjektif — ketertiban Owl dan kreativitas Nightingale keduanya memiliki keunggulan masing-masing; Falcon menolak memilih pemenang. Kunci bank: E.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 01 Narrative Text Latihan no. 16 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: E); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Which of the following are language features of a narrative text? (Choose every correct answer!)
opsi: Simple present tense as the dominant tense
Past tense & temporal conjunctions
Saying and thinking verbs
Adverbial phrases of time
Quoted and reported speech
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Sidik jari narrative: past tense (rose, swept), konjungsi temporal (long ago, ultimately), saying/thinking verbs (demanded, believed), adverbial phrase of time (once upon a time), quoted/reported speech. Simple present adalah ciri descriptive/exposition, bukan narrative.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — language features sesuai ringkasan bank 01 §1.1-C)

ujiPemahaman.soal: Match each narrative kind with its best example!
opsi: Cinderella and her magical godmother
The tragic origin of Naka Cave
The journey of Inanna to the underworld
The owl and the nightingale debating beauty
A colony ship drifting toward a new planet
A straight news report of a flood (bukan jenis narrative)
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Fairy tale = dunia ajaib (Cinderella); legend = asal-usul tempat (Naka Cave); myth = dewa & kosmos (Inanna); fable = hewan berbudi (owl & nightingale); science fiction = teknologi masa depan (colony ship).
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — jenis narrative §1.1-D bank)

ujiPemahaman.soal: The correct order of narrative generic structure is ....
ujiPemahaman.hintFormat: Tulis empat stasiun berurutan, pisahkan koma
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Urutan stasiun narrative: Orientation (tokoh & latar) -> Complication (masalah) -> Resolution (penyelesaian) -> Coda (perubahan & pelajaran).
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — generic structure §1.1-B bank)

ujiPemahaman.soal: Read the Naga legend again in your module. In one sentence, state its moral value and quote ONE sentence from the text that supports it!
ujiPemahaman.jawaban: Rubrik: moral = kesombongan & prasangka menghancurkan keharmonisan (harmony is easily destroyed when pride and prejudice take over); pemimpin harus memimpin dengan bijak & kasih, bukan amarah; tindakan dalam amarah berakibat bencana. Kutipan pendukung mis.: "But for King U-Lue, the Naga King reserved a punishment far worse than death." atau kalimat kutukan di paragraf akhir.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Kunci pembahasan bank untuk soal moral (no. 5) menyebutkan tiga pesan: harmony is easily destroyed when pride and prejudice take over; leaders should lead with wisdom and compassion rather than anger; actions taken in rage can lead to catastrophic consequences. Siswa perlu menyebut minimal satu + kutipan pendukung.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — uraian moral value, rubrik dari pembahasan bank 08 no. 5)

bab.ringkasan: Descriptive = foto kata: identification + description, simple present & adjectives; strategi menjawab key characteristics, makna frasa, rujukan, dan tabel kategorisasi.

sections.teks: A. Descriptive Text: Kamera yang Menulis

Bila narrative adalah film, descriptive adalah foto beresolusi tinggi: teks yang menjelaskan bagaimana rupa seseorang atau benda — bentuk, sifat, jumlah, suasana — sehingga pembaca bisa MELIHATNYA di kepala. Social function-nya: to describe, represent, or reveal a person or object, abstract or concrete.

Soal descriptive menguji: kunci karakteristik utama (key characteristics), detail tersurat vs tersirat, makna frasa deskriptif ("glittering light"), rujukan kata, dan tabel kategorisasi. Semua jawaban berjejak pada kalimat deskripsi — jangan bawa pengetahuan luar.
B. Generic Structure & Language Features

Struktur descriptive hanya dua stasiun: Identification (memperkenalkan subjek utama: siapa/apa yang akan dideskripsikan) lalu Description (rincian yang membuat pembaca melihatnya jelas). Bahasa utamanya: simple present tense (fakta keadaan), fokus pada satu partisipan spesifik, kata sifat padat, dan action verbs untuk gerak subjek.

sections.keterangan: Bagan dua stasiun descriptive: kotak biru Identification (memperkenalkan subjek: Tristan da Cunha, pulau vulkanik terisolasi) dengan panah ke kotak hijau Description (rincian: gunung berapi simetris, tebing curam, koloni penguin, permukiman Edinburgh of the Seven Seas); di samping kanan daftar ciri bahasa: simple present, adjectives, specific participant, action verbs.

items: Identification = paragraf pembuka: nama subjek + status unik (mis. "the most isolated inhabited island").
Description = paragraf berikutnya: geografi, flora-fauna, cuaca, kehidupan — rinci & sensorik.
Simple present menandai keadaan tetap; action verbs menandai gerak alam/subjek.
Kata sifat adalah "pixel" deskripsi: jagged, symmetrical, monochromatic — sering jadi soal makna frasa.

sections.teks: C. Cara Menjawab 4 Tipe Soal Descriptive

Contoh terpecah langkah — key characteristics (pola bank #2). Soal: pilihan mana yang paling menunjukkan karakteristik utama Tristan da Cunha dalam SELURUH teks? Langkah 1: kumpulkan jejak per paragraf: kepulauan vulkanik terpencil; kerucut vulcano simetris; akses hanya kapal beberapa hari; suaka margasatwa unik. Langkah 2: cocokkan dengan opsi yang memuat keempatnya -> kunci bank A. Langkah 3: opsi yang menyebut rainforest/flight/rail langsung gugur karena bertentangan dengan "no airports".

Contoh terpecah langkah — makna frasa (pola bank #7). "The entrance is illuminated by a glittering light installation." Glittering light = ? Langkah 1: cari kontras konteks: pintu masuk terlihat dari bermil-mil di lanskap kutub gelap. Langkah 2: makna = shines brightly like a beacon against the dark polar landscape -> kunci bank A. Langkah 3: opsi "hidden under snow" bertentangan dengan kata visible.

Descriptive = WHAT IS IT LIKE? Kumpulkan kata sifat per paragraf; jawaban benar biasanya PARA-FRASE dari kumpulan itu. Tabel kategorisasi: cocokkan tiap kondisi dengan kata kunci sumbernya (naturally frozen = environmental; three-ply foil packages = technical).

Latihan live: tampilkan satu foto benda di kelas, minta siswa menulis Identification 1 kalimat + Description 2 kalimat dalam 3 menit — lalu tukar dan tebak bendanya. Ini melatih struktur sebelum masuk soal bank.

ujiPemahaman.soal: Why is Tristan da Cunha considered a unique location for human settlement?
opsi: It is located very close to the continental landmass of Africa.
It features luxury resorts and modern airports for easy access.
Its geography consists entirely of flat plains and tropical forests.
It is a place where residents can enjoy the digital noise of modern life.
It is the most isolated inhabited island on Earth, far from any continent.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Paragraf 1: "As the most isolated inhabited island on Earth, it is defined by its dramatic and formidable geography." Justru keterpencilan ekstrem itu yang membuatnya unik; opsi lain bertentangan langsung dengan teks (no airports, no luxury resorts). Kunci bank: E.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 1 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: E); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Which of the following options best shows the key characteristics of Tristan da Cunha as told in the whole text?
opsi: (1) Remote volcanic archipelago (2) Symmetrical volcanic cone (3) Multi-day ship journey (4) Unique wildlife sanctuary
(1) Tropical coastal island (2) Dense rainforest canopy (3) Daily international flight (4) Luxury tourism destination
(1) Flat continental landmass (2) Massive industrial plateau (3) High-speed rail connection (4) Crowded metropolitan center
(1) Modern maritime territory (2) Jagged limestone cliff (3) Seasonal luxury cruise (4) Global commercial harbor
(1) Isolated desert outpost (2) Arid rocky landscape (3) Regular military transport (4) Scientific research station
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Karakteristik utama yang mencakup keseluruhan teks: (1) statusnya kepulauan vulkanik terpencil; (2) kerucut vulkanik Queen Mary's Peak yang simetris; (3) akses hanya kapal multi-hari dari Afrika Selatan; (4) suaka margasatwa unik (penguin, albatros). Kunci bank: A.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 2 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: A); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Decide whether the following statements are True or False based on the Tristan da Cunha text!
baris: Tristan da Cunha is the most isolated inhabited island on Earth.
Queen Mary's Peak is a dormant volcano that never experiences mist.
The island can be reached quickly by taking a flight from South Africa.
Edinburgh of the Seven Seas is the only human settlement on the island.
The island's vegetation consists of dense tropical forests and tall trees.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: True: paragraf 1 "the most isolated inhabited island on Earth". False: puncak justru active volcano yang sering menghilang dalam kabut. False: tidak ada bandara; akses kapal berhari-hari. True: Edinburgh of the Seven Seas adalah satu-satunya permukiman. False: vegetasi = pakis & lumut keras, bukan hutan tropis. Kunci bank: T, F, F, T, F.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 5 (kunci & pembahasan per pernyataan dari 08: T,F,F,T,F); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: The author mentioned the entrance is "illuminated by a glittering light installation that makes it visible for miles". The phrase "glittering light" describes the entrance ....
opsi: shines brightly like a beacon against the dark polar landscape
is hidden under the snow and only visible during the daytime
glows with gold and silver treasures stored inside the mountain
appears small and round like a star falling from the Arctic sky
flickers inconsistently due to the extreme freezing temperatures
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Frasa "glittering light" menunjukkan kontras terang di tengah kegelapan kutub; deskripsi pintu masuk sebagai concrete wedge yang menonjol dari gunung bersalju, diterangi instalasi cahaya yang terlihat bermil-mil -> shines brightly like a beacon against the dark polar landscape. Kunci bank: A.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 7 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: A); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: What idea does the text suggest about the Global Seed Vault?
opsi: The challenges of building a facility in a bustling modern city
The negative impact of cooling systems on the surrounding permafrost
The economic growth of the Svalbard archipelago through seed tourism
The competition between nations to build their own "Doomsday Vaults"
The importance of global cooperation in safeguarding future food security
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Teks menyatakan fasilitas ini penting untuk menjaga keberlangsungan pangan di masa depan bagi berbagai bangsa ("provides a sense of security for nations that rely on these biological resources") -> pentingnya kerja sama global menjaga ketahanan pangan. Kunci bank: E.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 8 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: E); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Which detail would best persuade people about the importance of the Seed Vault?
opsi: The role of the vault as a global insurance policy against disasters
The specialized four-ply foil packets used to store the seed samples
The specific depth of 120 meters carved into the sandstone mountain
The architectural design of the rectangular concrete wedge at the entrance
The distance of the facility from the bustling cities of the modern world
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Detail paling persuasif = fungsinya sebagai cadangan keamanan pangan global: "The facility functions as a secure backup for the world's crop diversity... protects millions of seed samples from natural disasters and human conflicts." Kunci bank: A.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 9 (kunci & pembahasan dari 08: A); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Categorize the following conditions based on the design of the Seed Vault into Environmental Factors or Technical Protection. Put a tick on each category!
baris: Use of the surrounding permafrost to stay naturally frozen.
Storage of samples in specialized three-ply foil packages.
Constant -18 C temperature maintained by cooling systems.
Location 120 meters deep inside a solid sandstone mountain.
A striking concrete wedge and massive steel doors.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Environmental = yang disediakan alam: permafrost pembeku alami (E) dan lokasi 120 m dalam gunung batu pasir (E). Technical = buatan fasilitas: paket foil tiga lapis (T), pendingin penjaga -18 C (T), baji beton & pintu baja (T). Kunci bank: E, T, T, E, T.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Bank Soal Sukses TKA 26 Bhs Inggris (@my99dreams) — 02 Descriptive Text Latihan no. 10 (kunci dari 08: E,T,T,E,T); transkrip verbatim

ujiPemahaman.soal: Which of the following are language features of descriptive text? (Choose every correct answer!)
opsi: Simple present tense
Focus on a specific participant
Adjectives
Action verbs
Temporal conjunctions as dominant connectors
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Ciri bahasa descriptive (§2.1-C bank): simple present tense, fokus pada partisipan spesifik, adjectives, action verbs. Temporal conjunctions adalah ciri narrative, bukan descriptive.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — language features §2.1-C bank)

ujiPemahaman.soal: Match each sentence to its generic-structure station in a descriptive text!
premis: Tristan da Cunha is a remote volcanic archipelago in the South Atlantic.
The coastline is characterized by sheer, jagged cliffs.
The Great Blue Hole spans over 300 meters across.
Its waters host Caribbean reef sharks and hammerhead sharks.
Long ago, a king ruled a magnificent city near the Mekong River.
opsi: Identification
Description
Description
Description
Bukan descriptive (narrative orientation)
Explanation of how a volcano erupts (explanation text)
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Kalimat pembuka yang memperkenalkan subjek = Identification; rincian bentang alam & isi = Description; kalimat "Long ago, a king..." berpola narrative (orientation), bukan descriptive.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — identification vs description)

ujiPemahaman.soal: The two generic structures of descriptive text, in order, are ....
ujiPemahaman.hintFormat: Tulis dua stasiun berurutan, pisahkan koma
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Descriptive = Identification (memperkenalkan subjek) lalu Description (merinci agar pembaca melihatnya jelas).
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — generic structure §2.1-B bank)

ujiPemahaman.soal: Choose one object in your classroom. Write ONE identification sentence and TWO description sentences using at least three adjectives, in simple present tense!
ujiPemahaman.jawaban: Rubrik: identification memperkenalkan subjek secara jelas (mis. "Our classroom whiteboard is the most-used object in this room."); dua kalimat description memuat >=3 adjectives keseluruhan (mis. wide, glossy, squeaky) dan simple present; tidak mencampur past tense.
ujiPemahaman.pembahasan: Penilaian: (1) subjek spesifik disebut di identification; (2) rincian sensorik/visual di description; (3) minimal tiga adjectives; (4) konsisten simple present. Contoh unggul meniru pola teks Tristan: status unik dulu, lalu rincian.
ujiPemahaman.sumber: Gemilang Drill (latihan orisinal sistem — menulis descriptive pendek)
